title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-04-15
source: Owsley's Master Sounboard Cassette > cass > DAT > CD

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality soundboard capture of a rocking performance, but the recording is cut short – the "It’s a Sin" segment disappears after 30 seconds.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers a high‑energy version of the show, with reviewers especially noting the “most rocking” rendition of Doin’ That Rag. The soundboard source is praised for its clarity and is considered better than earlier audience recordings, yet the set is frustratingly brief; the opening of "It’s a Sin" cuts out before any lyric, leaving the best part of the concert missing.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and highlighted a strong performance despite the truncated track, indicating solid show quality and decent recording fidelity, but the missing portion prevents a higher overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and balanced soundboard mix, noted as better than earlier audience tape; however the recording is incomplete – "It’s a Sin" ends after ~30 seconds, making the set feel short.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic and rocking overall, but the performance is cut short, leaving out what reviewers consider the best part of the show.
